SELECT distinct A.FINPROD_MARKET_ID id, A.FINPROD_ABBR text, nvl(A.FINPROD_ID,'') || ',' || nvl(B.IS_CYCLE,'') || ',' || nvl(B.DEAL_MODE,'') || ',' || nvl(C.CASH_ID,'') || ',' || nvl(A.PROFIT_TYPE,'') || ',' || nvl(to_char(A.VDATE,'yyyy-MM-dd'),'') || ',' || nvl(decode(D.OPEN_TYPE, #{openType03}, #{openType03}, #{openType01}),'') ||',' || nvl(to_char(A.MDATE,'yyyy-MM-dd'),'') object FROM FIN_PRODUCT A INNER JOIN PTL_MANAGE_OBJ ON PTL_MANAGE_OBJ.MANAGE_OBJ_ID = A.FINPROD_ID INNER JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO_AUTHORITY ON PTL_MANAGE_OBJ.PORTFOLIO_ID = PTL_PORTFOLIO_AUTHORITY.PORTFOLIO_ID, FIN_PRODUCT_ADD B, FIN_CASH_INFO C, FIN_OPEN_RULE D
WHERE A.FINPROD_ID = B.FINPROD_ID AND A.OPERATION_TYPE = #{ISSUE_MODE_01,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND A.FINPROD_ID = C.FINPROD_ID AND C.CASH_ID = D.CASH_ID AND D.OPEN_MODE != #{OPENMODE_02,jdbcType=VARCHAR} /*AND A.FINPROD_ID = E.FINPROD_ID*/
AND (A.FINPROD_MARKET_ID LIKE CONCAT('%',CONCAT (#{search,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'%')) or A.FINPROD_ABBR LIKE CONCAT('%',CONCAT (#{search,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'%')) )
AND PTL_PORTFOLIO_AUTHORITY.USER_ID = #{userName}
